text:
Cam: Dropping an updated mock for API Key management—focus on create/rotate/revoke UX, empty states, and accessibility. Figma: https://figma.com/...

Ravi: Quick notes: keep the list compact. Where do we show the secret after creating a key?

Cam: One-time modal reveal with copy button, no auto-copy. Modal traps focus.

Sasha: For revoke, current pattern is typing the key name. That feels heavy for personal keys. Can we adapt?

ellen: Adaptive confirm sounds good: require name typing for org-level keys, a checkbox for user keys.

a11y-bot: Accessibility: ensure modal role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and confirm input has aria-describedby to the irreversible warning. Also set focus to first interactive element.

Ravi: Rotate modal copy: change to: "A new key will be issued immediately. The previous key will stop accepting requests after 3 minutes to allow a short migration window." Add link to migration guide.

Sasha: Agree. Also, surface scopes as "N scopes" collapsed with accessible expansion. Expanded list should be focusable and read by screen readers.

ellen: Tab order fix: checkbox -> name -> scopes -> created -> actions. Tooltips must not be in tab order.

a11y-bot: Kebab menu must be keyboard operable (Enter/Space to open, Arrows to navigate). Menu items should include the key name in aria-labels: "Rotate key <name>", "Revoke key <name>".

Cam: Toasts for secrets are risky. We'll switch to modal reveal and make copy button accessible with aria-label "Copy secret for <key-name>". No auto-dismiss.

Ravi: Empty state copy: "You don't have any API keys yet — create one to start making requests." Primary CTA "Create API key"; secondary link "Key best practices". If user lacks perms show "Request access" link.

Sasha: For mobile, collapse rows into cards and ensure actions aren't hover-only.

Cam: Thanks — I'll update the Figma with adaptive revoke, rotate copy with 3-minute window, modal reveal, reordered DOM, and export CSV action. Will push copy + a11y checklist to the ticket after lunch.

ellen: I'll add keyboard/VoiceOver test cases tomorrow.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run axe-core on component stories after updates.

Cam: Great, closing thread once Figma updated. :thumbsup:
